title: Skeptical cinematographer Michael convinced by the Mia tests

tellings.quote: generally a skeptic in my life for most things but through seeing this I can't it's hard for me to not believe this stuff

plain: In 2023 in Glendale, California, a cinematographer named Michael watched tests of Mia, a child said to be able to read minds, and says they convinced him. The tests were filmed for The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary by the filmmaker Ky Dickens about children who are said to share thoughts without speaking. Michael, who says he was there, explains that he is "generally a skeptic in my life for most things," but after seeing this, "it's hard for me to not believe this stuff."
